description.value: Lumiere Cafe is a multi-location Vancouver artisanal coffee cafe specializing in micro-batch roasting of single-origin beans sourced from Ethiopia, Colombia, Rwanda, Kenya, and other origins. Their mission centres on an elevated cafe experience using high-quality ingredients and advanced preparation techniques. The West Broadway location sits near the Cambie Street intersection in a busy urban corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Lumiere Cafe is a multi-location artisanal coffee cafe in Vancouver focused on micro-batch roasting; the contact page references a 'West Broadway & Cambie' branch matching the OSM address, and the OSM URL matches the website URL. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all required criteria and most optional amenities default to null. The OSM tag 'level=1' indicates the cafe is on the second floor, which is a relevant concern for cyclists.
concerns: OSM tag 'level=1' indicates the cafe is on the second floor, which could affect bike visibility from the street and accessibility for cyclists with loaded bikes.
Website navigation displays 'Signed in as: filler@godaddy.com', indicating the site was built from a GoDaddy template and the demo account was never removed — the site may be minimally maintained.
No phone number is present in OSM or on the website.
Website does not publish a specific street address; the match to 521 West Broadway is inferred from the OSM record and the 'West Broadway & Cambie' contact label on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Lumiere Cafe is a legitimate operating business, but none of the three required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. Direct contact or an on-site visit is needed to determine whether it meets the minimum WWC bar.
